== Notes ==
* Has no [[duration]] (this is one of the few [[Upkeep#Skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep|skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep]]).
* Ends with no effect upon using a Healing Prayers resurrection spell.
* Skills such as [[Aegis]], [[Heal Party]], and [[Light of Deliverance]] that are not targetable will not trigger the healing effect and will not end Boon Signet.
* Although the skill's descriptions suggest an increase to a spell's base healing, the spell does not have to have an innate healing effect to gain the benefit of Boon Signet.
